rows.text: The release dated 20 May 2014 states that an NDA delegation led by Rajnath Singh met the President at 14:30 with a letter that Narendra Modi had been elected leader of the BJP Parliamentary Party, that Modi called on the President at 15:15, and that, as the BJP had majority support in the House of the People, the President appointed him as the Prime Minister of India and asked him to advise the names of other ministers.
The same release states that the President will administer the oath of office and secrecy on 26 May 2014 at 18:00 at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
